claims.evidence: ID plate in Photo 1 is present but text is not legible; no brand or model was read by the witness, so Caterpillar C9 cannot be confirmed or denied from the photos.
Photos show the bare engine block and valve cover only; turbocharger, injectors, alternator, starter and other bolt-on components are not shown, so completeness cannot be confirmed.
No start-up video or running sound clip was captured, so working condition (or lack thereof) cannot be judged from the photos.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or have major internal faults (cracked block, seized pistons, etc.)
risks.proof: Video clip of engine cranking/starting, or a compression/leak-down test result

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete ancillary components (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter, ECU)
risks.proof: Additional photos showing each side of the engine and all mounted accessories
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing standard accessories

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed as Caterpillar C9
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the legible ID/serial plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded industrial diesel engine, not as a confirmed Caterpillar C9

risks.risk: Unknown usage history and wear level
risks.proof: Photo of hour meter or any service/maintenance paperwork
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-hour, heavily used unit

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, corrosion, or damage under dirt/oil staining
risks.proof: Close-up photos of block seams, gaskets, and underside after a wipe-down

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the ID/serial plate showing full legible text
Video of the engine being cranked or started, with audio
Photos of all sides of the engine showing presence/absence of turbo, injectors, alternator, starter
Photo of hour meter or any maintenance/service records
Close-up photos of the block and gasket areas after cleaning to check for cracks or leaks
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial diesel engine, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-brand, non-running, possibly incomplete unit pending the listed proofs.
